title: Exercise Units Recalled by Nautilus Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The footpads on the unit can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 400.

title: Homelite, Husky and Black Max Generators Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot and Sam's Club Stores
summary: The fuel gauge can leak excessive amounts of gasoline, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 51,750.

title: Little Tikes Recalls Children's Toy Workshop Sets and Trucks Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The recalled workshop sets and trucks have oversized, plastic toy nails that can pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1.6 Million.

title: Wii(tm) Battery Recharge Stations Recalled by Griffin International Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The battery pack can overheat, posing a burn or fire hazard to the consumer. Units: About 220,000.

title: Dorel Juvenile Group Expands Recall of Safety 1st Stair Gates Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The hinges that hold the stair gate in place can break, posing a fall hazard to children if the gate is placed at the top of the stairs. Units: About 31,500 (100,000 units were previously recalled in February 2009).

title: Jump 'n Jive Doorway Jumpers Recalled by Graco Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The recalled doorway jumpers include detachable toys that are attached to the jumper straps with strips of hook and loop fabric. The strips of fabric are not permanently attached to the toys and can become detached during use, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 2,400.

title: Target Recalls Circo Booster Seats Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The booster seat restraint buckle can open unexpectedly, allowing a child to fall from the chair and be injured. Units: About 43,000.

title: Paper Towel Dispensers Recalled By Global Plastics Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The dispenser's electric board can overheat posing a fire hazard. Units: 14000.

title: Baby Hammocks Recalled by Kaplan Early Learning Due to Fall and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The hammock can flip over, posing a serious fall hazard and strangulation hazard to infants who become entrapped in the seat's restraint straps while upside down. Units: About 200 (Related recalls have been issued: #08-604 and #09-760).

title: Baby Hammocks Recalled by Nova Natural Toys & Crafts Due to Fall and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The hammock can flip over, posing a serious fall hazard and strangulation hazard to infants who become entrapped in the seat's restraint straps while upside down. Units: About 265 (Related recalls have been issued: #08-604 and #09-761).

title: Increasing Injuries Prompt Black & Decker to Reannounce Recall of Trimmers/Edgers Due to Laceration and Burn Hazards
summary: The trimmer/edger's spool, spool cap and pieces of trimmer string can come loose during use and become airborne projectiles, posing a serious laceration hazard to the user, as well as bystanders. The trimmer/edgers can also overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 200,000.

title: Polaris Recalls Ranger Side-by-Side Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical short can lead to overheating in the rear tail light wiring harnesses, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,800.

title: Ross Stores Recalls Plant Stands; Marble Top Can Detach and Fall on Consumers
summary: The marble top of the plant stand can detach from the base and fall onto consumers, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 1,800.

title: Spalding In-Ground Basketball Hoops Recalled By Russell Brands Due to Impact Hazard
summary: The bolts at the base can fail, causing the unit to fall. This poses a risk of serious injury to consumers. Units: About 1,700.

title: Baby Jogger Recalls Strollers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The stroller's restraint buckle could break or unlatch allowing the child or infant to fall out. Units: About 41,000.

title: Frigidaire and Kenmore Smoothtop Electric Ranges Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Depending on the model, the surface heating elements can: 1) turn on spontaneously without being switched on; 2) fail to turn off after being switched off; or, 3) heat to different temperatures than selected. This poses a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 200,000.

title: Liquidation Outlet, Inc. Recalls Action Figure Toys Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard; Sold Exclusively at Dollar Stores
summary: The action figure toys have surface paints which contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 8,400.

title: Quiksilver Recalls Girls' Hoodies with Waist Drawstrings Due to Entrapment Hazard
summary: The cotton hoodie has a waist drawstring that could pose an entrapment hazard to children. Units: About 500.

title: Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard Prompts Recall of Sofa-bed Mattresses by IKEA
summary: The mattress and seat cushions intended to be used as a mattress fail to meet the mandatory federal open flame standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 500.

title: Near Strangulation of Children Prompts Recall of Roman Shades; Sold Exclusively at Pottery Barn Kids
summary: Strangulations can occur when a child places his/her neck between the exposed inner cord and the fabric on the backside of the blind or when a child pulls the cord out and wraps it around his/her neck. Units: About 85,000 units.

title: Near Strangulation Prompts Recall of Roman Blinds; Sold Exclusively at IKEA
summary: Strangulations can occur when a child places his/her neck between the exposed inner cord and the fabric on the backside of the blind or when a child pulls the cord out and wraps it around his/her neck. The Roman blind has a continuous looped bead chain that when not attached to the wall or floor, ha

title: Risk of Strangulation Prompts Recall to Repair Roller Shades by Lutron Shading Solutions
summary: Strangulations can occur if the shade's looped bead chain is not attached to the wall or the floor and a child's neck becomes entangled on the free-standing loop. Units: About 245,000.

title: Risk of Strangulation Prompts Recall to Repair Victoria Classics Roman Shades; Sold Exclusively by Target Stores
summary: Strangulations can occur when a child places his/her neck between the exposed inner cord and the fabric on the backside of the blind or when a child pulls the cord out and wraps it around his/her neck. Exposed operating cords can knot or tangle creating a strangulation loop. Units: About 163,000.

title: Strangulation Death of a Child Prompts Recall To Repair Window Blinds By Vertical Land
summary: Horizontal Blinds: The blinds do not have inner cord stop devices to prevent the accessible inner cords from being pulled out. If an inner cord is pulled out, a child can become entangled in the loop and strangle. Vertical Blinds: Strangulations can occur if a child's neck becomes entangled on the f

title: Strangulation Deaths of Children Prompt Recall to Repair of Roll-Up Blinds and Roman Shades by Lewis Hyman Inc.
summary: Strangulations can occur if the lifting loops slide off the side of the blind and a child's neck becomes entangled on the free-standing loop or if a child places his/her neck between the lifting loop and the roll-up blind material. Roman Shades: Strangulations can occur when a child places his/her n

title: Ameriwood Recalls Entertainment Stands Sold Exclusively at Walmart Stores Due to Tip-Over Hazard
summary: Warning labels sold with the entertainment stands indicate incorrect size and weight limits for televisions used with the stands. A television that is too heavy or wide for the entertainment stand can make the unit unstable, posing a tip-over hazard to consumers. Units: About 195.

title: Maytag Expands Recall of Refrigerators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical failure in the relay, the component that turns on the refrigerator's compressor, can cause overheating and pose a serious fire hazard. Units: About 46,000 (1.6 million units were previously recalled March 2009).

title: Pella Recalls Casement Windows Due to Impact Hazard
summary: The hinge can break, causing the window sash to fall out, posing a risk of injury to persons beneath the window. Units: About 6,500.

title: Cloth Books Recalled by Sterling Publishing Co. Inc. Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: A string attaching a ball to the book can become entangled in the basketball hoop element, posing a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 15,000.

title: DVD Players Recalled by Wal-Mart Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The DVD players can overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1.5 Million.

title: Pensi Ceiling Fans Recalled by The Modern Fan Co. Due to Fall and Injury Hazard
summary: The internal coupler that connects the down rod assembly to the motor can break and cause the fan to fall from the ceiling, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,300.

title: Weight Watchers Recalls Plush Hungry Figures and Magnets Due to Puncture Hazard
summary: Sewing needles have been found in the stuffing of the Hungry Figures, posing a puncture hazard to consumers. Units: About 420,000 in the United States and 25,000 in Canada.

title: Amplifiers Recalled by Krell Industries Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The amplifiers were designed to operate at a temperature warm to the touch. However, a component input device can fail and cause the amplifiers to overheat, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 2,300.

title: Bicycles Recalled by Nirve Sports; Stem Failure Poses Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle stem can crack and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of serious injury if the rider falls. Units: About 120.

title: Burley Design Recalls Child Trailers Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The axle assembly's internal sleeve can loosen, causing one wheel to separate from the trailer. This poses a risk of injury to the child occupant or bike rider. Units: About 2,700.

title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Cyclocross Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle's fork steerer tube can break, causing the rider to lose control and fall, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 1,500.

title: Ridgid Table Saws Sold Exclusively at Home Depot Recalled by One World Technologies Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The table saw's arbor shaft can fail when used with a stacked blade set (commonly known as a "stacked dado set"), which is used to cut grooves. The stacked blade set can be ejected from the saw, posing a potential laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,000.

title: Black & Decker Coffeemakers Recalled By Applica Consumer Products Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The coffeemakers can overheat and melt, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 9,800.

title: Remote Switches Recalled by Woodstock International Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An incorrectly sized wire inside the remote switch can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 450.
